summary: Iteration 40: WhatsApp Baileys QR integration validated end-to-end. Node sidecar (port 3002, supervised) generates QR; FastAPI proxy /api/whatsapp-baileys/* serves it; React WhatsAppQRPanel renders QR + state badge 'Conectando...'. All 7 backend tests pass (4 baileys + 3 regressions). UI flow verified: login admin -> Atendimento IA -> WhatsApp (QR) tab -> QR image (7518 chars data:image/png;base64) displayed, badge 'Conectando...', refresh works, no crash. Sidebar Clientes->Assinantes and other AIHub tabs (jerusa, agents) regressions pass.
critical_code_review_comments: phone_normalizer.link_phone_to_subscriber is imported lazily inside the inbound handler each call — fine for clarity, but consider top-level import or LRU cache to avoid repeated module lookups under high-volume inbound.

inbound_webhook is mounted with NO auth on /api prefix — production safety relies entirely on supervisor binding to 127.0.0.1; if k8s ingress ever exposes /api/whatsapp-baileys/inbound publicly, anyone can inject messages. Recommend adding a shared-secret header (env WA_INBOUND_TOKEN) and have sidecar pass it.
Hardcoded DEMO_COMPANY_ID in inbound handler with TODO note — multi-tenant routing is unresolved. Will need a phone-to-tenant lookup or a webhook URL per tenant.
send_message logs outbound to aihub_wa_messages, but on sidecar 5xx the exception bubbles before logging — acceptable, but consider logging failed attempts with status='error'.
WhatsAppQRPanel polls QR every 3s — keep an eye on bandwidth; QR ~7.5KB * 1 panel open = ~150KB/min per session. Consider stopping the QR poll once status='open'.
seed_data_creation: Inserted one inbound test message (message_id=TEST1, phone=5521999990001) into aihub_wa_messages for assertion. Not cleaned up; harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Node sidecar 'whatsapp-service' runs at 127.0.0.1:3002 (supervisor managed). Health: curl http://127.0.0.1:3002/health. Auth dir at /app/whatsapp-service/auth_info/ — do NOT delete or call /logout in tests. To verify QR live: curl with admin Bearer token to /api/whatsapp-baileys/qr — expect data:image/png;base64,... > 4000 chars. Sidecar logs at /var/log/supervisor/whatsapp-service.out.log.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Sidecar+proxy+UI integration working as designed.
